name: HHS OCR Breach Portal
regulator: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Office for Civil Rights
unit_of_observation: One public portal row for a breach affecting 500 or more individuals
source_threshold: The public list covers reported breaches of unsecured protected health information affecting 500 or more individuals.
source_population: HIPAA cases in the current investigated and archive windows.
public_window: The current list describes the last 24 months and separate archive behavior.
source_licence: United States federal government source material; publication terms remain subject to source review.
attribution: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Office for Civil Rights
correction_process: Review the official portal and HHS reporting guidance.
limitations: The verified public list is a stateful JSF interface.
No stable bounded machine-readable export was identified.
Browser automation and submission endpoints are deliberately unsupported.
